summary: Vale S.A. (NYSE: VALE) filed a Form 6-K attaching minutes of an extraordinary Board of Directors meeting held June 19, 2026. The board, upon request from shareholder Previ (Caixa de Previdência dos Funcionários do Banco do Brasil), resolved to call an Extraordinary General Meeting to deliberate on (i) the removal of Board Chairman Daniel André Stieler, (ii) election of a new board member, and (iii) election of a new board chair. No price, premium, or value terms apply as this is a governance activist campaign seeking board-level change. Directors attending included all 13 members; legal advisors were present. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and potential further board restructuring.
